content.text: rained upon Sodom … brimstone and fire, Gen. 19:24. the bush burned with fire, Ex. 3:2. the fire ran along upon the ground, Ex. 9:23. in a pillar of fire, to give them light, Ex. 13:21. Lord descended upon it in fire, Ex. 19:18. Ye shall kindle no fire … upon the sabbath day, Ex. 35:3. fire was on it by night, Ex. 40:38 (Num. 9:16). food of the offering made by fire, Lev. 3:11 (21:6). there came a fire out from before the Lord, Lev. 9:24. went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, Lev. 10:2. not let any of thy seed pass through the fire, Lev. 18:21. fire of the Lord burnt among them, Num. 11:1. fire from the Lord, and consumed the … men, Num. 16:35. mountain burned with fire, Deut. 4:11. thy God is a consuming fire, Deut. 4:24 (Heb. 12:29). Lord talked … out of the midst of the fire, Deut. 5:4. sons and … daughters they have burnt in the fire, Deut. 12:31 (18:10; 2 Kgs. 16:3; 17:17; 21:6; 2 Chr. 28:3; 33:6; Jer. 7:31; 19:5; 32:35; Ezek. 20:26). fire is kindled in mine anger, Deut. 32:22. fire out of the rock, Judg. 6:21. let fire come out of the bramble, Judg. 9:15. fire out of his mouth devoured, 2 Sam. 22:9 (Ps. 18:8). fire of the Lord fell, and consumed, 1 Kgs. 18:38. a fire; but the Lord was not in the fire, 1 Kgs. 19:12. fire come down from heaven, 2 Kgs. 1:10 (1:12; Luke 9:54). appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, 2 Kgs. 2:11. answered him from heaven by fire, 1 Chr. 21:26. made an end of praying, the fire came down, 2 Chr. 7:1. a fire shall devour before him, Ps. 50:3. fire was kindled against Jacob, Ps. 78:21. Who maketh … his ministers a flaming fire, Ps. 104:4 (Heb. 1:7). in his lips there is as a burning fire, Prov. 16:27. heap coals of fire upon his head, Prov. 25:22 (Rom. 12:20). Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out, Prov. 26:20. shining of a flaming fire by night, Isa. 4:5. as the fire devoureth the stubble, Isa. 5:24. visited of the Lord of hosts … the flame of devouring fire, Isa. 29:6. Lord, whose fire is in Zion, Isa. 31:9. Who … shall dwell with the devouring fire, Isa. 33:14. through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, Isa. 43:2. when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, Isa. 64:2. Lord will come with fire, Isa. 66:15. shall their fire be quenched, Isa. 66:24 (Mark 9:44, 46, 48). I will make my words in thy mouth fire, Jer. 5:14. word was in mine heart as a burning fire, Jer. 20:9. Is not my word like as a fire, Jer. 23:29. came out of the north … a fire infolding itself, Ezek. 1:4. I will plead against him with … fire, and brimstone, Ezek. 38:22. I will send a fire on Magog, Ezek. 39:6. four men loose … in the midst of the fire, Dan. 3:25. blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke, Joel 2:30 (Acts 2:19; D&C 45:41). Seek the Lord … lest he break out like fire, Amos 5:6. be unto her a wall of fire, Zech. 2:5. he is like a refiner’s fire, Mal. 3:2 (D&C 128:24).

hewn down, and cast into the fire, Matt. 3:10 (7:19; Luke 3:9; 3 Ne. 27:11). baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire, Matt. 3:11 (Luke 3:16). fool, shall be in danger of hell fire, Matt. 5:22. tares are gathered and burned in the fire, Matt. 13:40. Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, Matt. 25:41 (D&C 29:28). wilt thou that we command fire to come, Luke 9:54. I am come to send fire on the earth, Luke 12:49. rained fire and brimstone from heaven, Luke 17:29. shall be revealed by fire, 1 Cor. 3:13. In flaming fire taking vengeance on them, 2 Thes. 1:8. Quenched the violence of fire, Heb. 11:34. tongue is a fire, James 3:6. gold … tried with fire, 1 Pet. 1:7 (Rev. 3:18). reserved unto fire against the day of judgment, 2 Pet. 3:7. heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, 2 Pet. 3:12. suffering the vengeance of eternal fire, Jude 1:7. save with fear, pulling them out of the fire, Jude 1:23. his eyes were as a flame of fire, Rev. 1:14. hail and fire mingled with blood, Rev. 8:7. sea of glass mingled with fire, Rev. 15:2. both were cast alive into a lake of fire, Rev. 19:20. fire came down from God, Rev. 20:9. devil … was cast into the lake of fire, Rev. 20:10. death and hell were cast into the lake of fire, Rev. 20:14 (21:8).

there came a pillar of fire, 1 Ne. 1:6. justice of God … like unto the brightness of a flaming fire, 1 Ne. 15:30. believe not … destroyed, both by fire, 2 Ne. 6:15. fire devoureth the stubble, 2 Ne. 15:24. light of Israel shall be for a fire, 2 Ne. 20:17. fire of the anger of the Lord shall be kindled, 2 Ne. 26:6. destroy the wicked by fire, 2 Ne. 30:10. branches that have not … good fruit, and cast them into the fire, Jacob 5:26. vineyard will I cause to be burned with fire, Jacob 5:77. world shall be burned with fire, Jacob 6:3. ye must go away into that lake of fire and brimstone, Jacob 6:10. unquenchable fire, whose flame ascendeth up forever, Mosiah 2:38 (D&C 43:33; 63:34; 101:66). this people … shall be cast into a lake of fire, Alma 14:14. encircled about as if by fire, Hel. 5:23 (5:24; 3 Ne. 17:24; 19:14). fire should come down out of heaven, Hel. 13:13. I did send down fire and destroy them, 3 Ne. 9:11. furnaces of fire … receiving no harm, 4 Ne. 1:32.

remission of sins by baptism, and by fire, D&C 19:31. day of my coming in a pillar of fire, D&C 29:12. by the fire of mine indignation will I preserve them, D&C 35:14 (Moses 7:34). earth shall pass away so as by fire, D&C 43:32. watched for iniquity shall be … cast into the fire, D&C 45:50. I will visit her … with devouring fire, D&C 97:26. they reside … on a globe like … fire, D&C 130:7. presence of the Lord shall be as the melting fire, D&C 133:41. like unto circling flames of fire, D&C 137:2.
